title: "Topic 5B: From filtered object to trustworthy computation"
toc: true

A persistence diagram is trustworthy only if the software built the intended
filtered object and retained enough dimensions to compute the requested
homology. This page makes that implementation contract explicit: inspect a
small construction, interpret package parameters and report what was actually
computed.

::: {.column-margin .study-note .insight}
**Relation to the spine.** Topic 5A reopens the modelling choices in stages 1
and 3. Here the complete strip becomes a software contract: verify that the
constructed cells, algebra and reported diagram match those choices.
:::

## Dimension determines cost

For an $N$-point Rips complex, there can be

$$
\binom{N}{k+1}
$$

$k$-simplices. Edges can therefore grow as $O(N^2)$, triangles as
$O(N^3)$ and tetrahedra as $O(N^4)$ in the worst case.

Homology in dimension $p$ depends on

$$
C_{p+1}\xrightarrow{\partial_{p+1}}C_p
\xrightarrow{\partial_p}C_{p-1}.
$$

To decide whether a $p$-cycle is filled, the computation needs
$(p+1)$-simplices. Correct $H_1$ therefore needs triangles; correct $H_2$
needs tetrahedra. Moving to a higher homology dimension can increase memory
and runtime long before it adds many intervals to the output.

::: {.column-margin .study-note .insight}
**Reading big $O$.** $O(N^3)$ describes worst-case growth, not a runtime in
seconds. Thresholds, sparsity and implementation matter, but doubling $N$ can
still make a cubic-size collection roughly eight times larger.
:::

The ambient coordinate dimension is different. A cloud in $\mathbb R^{20}$
can be analysed only in $H_0$ and $H_1$; the number of recorded coordinates
does not determine the homology degree worth computing.

## Software parameters do not share one convention

In GUDHI, `create_simplex_tree(max_dimension=1)` constructs only the Rips
graph and is not enough for correct $H_1$. In Ripser.py, `maxdim=1` names the
largest homology degree returned, and the algorithm handles the required
higher-dimensional information internally. Report what a parameter means in
the package actually used, rather than transferring a familiar name between
libraries.

The official [GUDHI Rips documentation](https://gudhi.inria.fr/python/latest/rips_complex_ref.html),
[Ripser.py API](https://ripser.scikit-tda.org/en/latest/reference/stubs/ripser.ripser.html)
and [Ripserer.jl API](https://mtsch.github.io/Ripserer.jl/v0.6/api/ripserer/)
document these different conventions.

## Inspect the construction before the barcode

A **simplex tree** is a software data structure for storing simplices, their
faces and filtration values. It makes a filtered complex efficient to query;
it is not a different kind of mathematical complex.

For a small subset, check:

- simplex or cell counts by dimension;
- several entry values by hand;
- whether clique expansion or downward closure added the expected cells;
- whether the filtration direction agrees with the scientific question; and
- whether infinite intervals were retained, censored or discarded.

:::: {.worked-example}
### Graph-only versus clique-complex persistence

Suppose edges $01$, $12$ and $02$ enter by $\varepsilon=0.45$. In a
one-dimensional graph they create a loop that cannot be filled. In the clique
complex, the triangle $[0,1,2]$ enters when its final edge appears and makes
that edge cycle a boundary immediately. The data and edge weights are
unchanged; only the higher-order assertion differs.
::::

:::: {.worked-example}
### Read a cubical sublevel filtration

In the scalar-grid figure on Topic 5A, low-valued cells first form a ring. The
central cell has value 5, so the one-dimensional class remains alive below
that value and dies when the centre enters. Its birth and death have
scalar-field units, not Euclidean-distance units.
::::

## Alternatives when Rips is too large

Alpha complexes use Delaunay geometry in Euclidean space. Witness complexes
retain selected landmarks while other observations support their relations.
Sparse Rips methods and threshold truncation provide other compromises. Each
changes the computational object or the range over which it is observed, so
the approximation and its parameters belong in the report. The original alpha
shape [@edelsbrunner1994alpha] and witness-complex
[@desilva2004witness] papers show what these constructions preserve and
discard. Geometric stability and approximation results provide the formal
background [@chazal2014geometric].

## Minimum computational report

Record:

- the starting object, shape, units and preprocessing;
- the metric, edge weight or scalar-field convention;
- the complex and filtration definition;
- the coefficient field and requested homology dimensions;
- maximum scale, truncation and sparsification;
- observation, simplex or cell counts;
- software and version; and
- runtime, memory failures and treatment of essential intervals.

The participant notebook applies the full pipeline audit protocol. The reader
needs only this contract: the barcode is interpretable after the constructed
object and the computation have both been checked.

## Checkpoints

You are ready to continue when you can explain why $H_p$ needs
$(p+1)$-simplices, translate a package's dimension option correctly, inspect a
small construction and produce a reproducible computational report.
